subject: Fathom Labs — Q3 surge readiness & renewal health brief
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@fathomlabs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fathom Labs — Q3 surge readiness & renewal health brief

Hi Elena —

Quick health snapshot ahead of your renewal window (Q3):

- Last 90 days: ~1.9B tokens consumed (70% generation, 30% embeddings/analytics).
- 30-day rolling p95 latency: 210ms (text-gen routes), error rate: 0.6% transient (mostly KV cache warmups).
- Usage trend: 28% month-over-month growth for product-side inference since feature launch on May 5.

Our predictive model flags a potential Q3 surge (~+40% peak), driven by two planned product rollouts you mentioned. If that manifests, you will see multiple short-lived latency spikes and higher unit cost without changes to routing or commit.

Recommended options (we can mix):
1) Commit uplift: +30% token commitment for 12 months — reduces unit by ~15% and gives burst credits.
2) Temporary Dedicated pilot: 2-week Dedicated pool for your heavy burst windows (isolates traffic, stabilizes latency).
3) Quantized model variant for low-latency agent flows (reduces per-token compute ~25%).
4) Autoscale + conservative prefix caching policy to limit cold KV penalties.

Attachments: monthly_token_report_May2027.csv, latency_p95_june2027.pdf (see charts and forecast).

Can we schedule a 30-min sync this week to walk through the ROI and what a 2-week Dedicated trial would look like? If helpful, we can loop in procurement for a quick addendum template.

Thanks —
Sean
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

Subject: Re: Fathom Labs — Q3 surge readiness & renewal health brief

Sean —

Thanks for the concise summary. The growth numbers line up with what we're seeing. A couple of quick asks:

- Can you provide a short ROI table that shows net cost delta for our expected Q3 profile (baseline vs +30% commit vs Dedicated trial)? Procurement will need that to evaluate the addendum.
- Is the Dedicated trial fully isolated (no cross-tenant sharing) and would Redwood support a canary switchback if any model regressions pop up?
- What's the lead time to spin the Dedicated pilot and can that happen before July 15?

Looping procurement here so they see the ask. We prefer numeric examples rather than percentages where possible.

—Elena
Head of Platform Engineering | Fathom Labs
elena.ortiz@fathomlabs.com

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fathom Labs — Q3 surge readiness & renewal health brief

Elena —

Putting numbers behind the options you asked for. Attached: ROI_case_study_v2.odt with worked examples. Summary table below. (All numbers approximate, we can run a precise per-route calc if you share sample traffic mix.)

Baseline (no change) — projected Q3 peak tokens: 2.7B
- Effective unit price (current mix, hosted): $0.024 / 1k tokens → projected spend: $64,800 / month at peak

Option A — +30% 12-month commit (fees amortized monthly)
- New unit: $0.020 / 1k tokens (15% reduction) → projected spend: $54,000 / month at peak
- Annualized savings vs baseline: ~$129,600 over 12 months (assuming steady state)

Option B — Dedicated trial (2-week pilot) + expected Dedicated rates post-trial
- Trial cost: waived for first 2 weeks if commit uplift agreed (pilot support included)
- Projected unit after migration/steady ops: $0.018 / 1k tokens → projected spend: $48,600 / month at peak
- Additional benefit: p95 latency expected to drop to ~120ms for gen flows

Option C — Hybrid (quantized variant for agent flows covering ~30% of tokens)
- Quantized unit delta: ~-25% on compute portion = net unit ~ $0.017 / 1k tokens for that subset
- Combined hybrid projection: blended effective unit ≈ $0.019 / 1k tokens → projected spend: $51,300 / month at peak
Quick notes:
- The math above includes conservative batching gains (10% tokens effectively reduced via aggregation) and predicted cache hit improvement with prefix caching.
- Dedicated pilot lead time: 5 business days to provision + 1 day for runbook & routing test.
- Canary/support: We provide automatic model fallback to your previous hosted variant for any regression signals, and our SRE will run the switchback within the pilot window if you request.

Proposed next steps:
1) If procurement is comfortable with the numbers, we prepare a 1-page addendum (deal RDW-2027-789) with a 30% uplift commitment option and 12-month term.
2) Schedule a 30-min technical run-through (ops + infra) and pick 2-week dates for the Dedicated pilot before July 15.

Attachments: ROI_case_study_v2.odt

Thanks —
Monica
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Monica / Sean —

Procurement here. Appreciate the ROI breakdown — helpful. A few procurement items:

- We will need a simple addendum template showing the commit uplift line item, billing cadence, and an SLA clause for Dedicated pilot availability.
- Can you confirm billing alignment (USD monthly invoicing to our AP team) and whether Redwood can absorb overage for the 2-week pilot period if we exceed the pilot cap?
- Also need a one-paragraph security note confirming Dedicated pool isolation and that logs/audit trails are retained per our standard 13-month retention policy.

We'll be able to sign a short addendum quickly if the above items are in place.

—Fathom Procurement (procurement@fathomlabs.com)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: procurement@fathomlabs.com, Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@fathomlabs.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fathom Labs — Q3 surge readiness & renewal health brief

Thanks — quick confirmations inline: 

- Addendum: We will send a 1-page addendum template by COB Monday that lists the +30% token commitment, monthly USD billing, and simplified SLA for Dedicated pilot availability.
- Pilot overages: Redwood will waive up to 10% overage during the 2-week pilot window to remove friction; any additional usage billed at standard Dedicated pilot rate.
- Security/isolation: Dedicated pools are single-tenant for the duration of the pilot; audit logs will be retained for 13 months and we will provide the standard security one-pager (SOC2 + KMS integration note).

Conditional commercial offer: If Fathom agrees to the +30% 12-month uplift by June 20, Redwood will extend a 15% first-year discount on the uplifted portion and include the 2-week Dedicated pilot at no charge (support + runbook).

Proposed dates for pilot provisioning window: July 5–16 (provisioning on July 2). Confirm and we'll schedule the technical run-through next week.

Onward —
Sean
